name: Ryoujoku Santa
source:
It is said that the Gods and angels do miracles on Christmas day. But good things and bad things existing in this world should be equal, otherwise it will lose its balance and might destroy the world. So the main character thinks it would be better if there is more unhappiness in this world. And the worst Santa Claus is born...

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090305045441/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/cPath/146_45/products_id/1005275]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
据说，每逢圣诞节，神明与天使都会创造奇迹。然而，世间的幸福与不幸必须保持均衡，否则世界便会失去平衡，甚至走向毁灭。主人公因此认为，世界上最好再多一些不幸。于是，史上最恶劣的圣诞老人诞生了……

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090305045441/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/cPath/146_45/products_id/1005275]Eroge Shop[/url]]
